import pytest
import dataclasses
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date, datetime as dt, timedelta
from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import clamp_ease

def test_above_minimum_returns_input_unchanged():
    result = clamp_ease(2.5)
    assert result == 2.5

def test_below_minimum_clamps_to_minimum():
    result = clamp_ease(1.0)
    assert result == 1.3

def test_at_minimum_returns_minimum():
    result = clamp_ease(1.3)
    assert result == 1.3

def test_negative_value_clamps_to_minimum():
    result = clamp_ease(-2.75)
    assert result == 1.3

def test_preserves_unrounded_value_above_minimum():
    result = clamp_ease(1.3000000000000003)
    assert result == 1.3000000000000003

import pytest
import dataclasses
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date, datetime as dt, timedelta
from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import learning_delay_days


def test_returns_selected_step_for_good():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3))
    step_index = 1
    hard = False
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == 3


def test_hard_uses_ceiling_of_one_point_five_times_delay():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3))
    step_index = 0
    hard = True
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == 2


def test_empty_steps_falls_back_to_one_and_hard_is_two():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=())
    step_index = 9
    hard = True
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == 2


def test_negative_step_index_clamps_to_first_step():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(2, 5))
    step_index = -1
    hard = False
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == 2


def test_oversized_step_index_clamps_to_last_step():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(2, 5))
    step_index = 99
    hard = False
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == 5


def test_nonpositive_steps_are_replaced_with_one():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(0, -4, 3))
    step_index = 1
    hard = False
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == 1


def test_hard_delay_never_below_one_after_step_normalization():
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(0,))
    step_index = 0
    hard = True
    result = learning_delay_days(settings, step_index, hard)
    assert result == 2

import dataclasses

from app.domain import *

from app.logic import is_leech


def test_lapses_equal_threshold_is_leech():
    card = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=10, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=8)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=8)
    result = is_leech(card, settings)
    assert result is True


def test_lapses_below_positive_threshold_is_not_leech():
    card = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=10, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=7)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=8)
    result = is_leech(card, settings)
    assert result is False


def test_lapses_above_positive_threshold_is_leech():
    card = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=10, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=9)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=8)
    result = is_leech(card, settings)
    assert result is True


def test_zero_threshold_disables_detection_even_with_many_lapses():
    card = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=10, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=100)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=0)
    result = is_leech(card, settings)
    assert result is False

    card = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.NEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=0)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=-1)
    result = is_leech(card, settings)
    assert result is False


def test_zero_lapses_meets_minimum_positive_threshold():
    card = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.NEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=0)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=1)
    result = is_leech(card, settings)
    assert result is False

import pytest
import dataclasses
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date, datetime as dt, timedelta
from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import schedule_new_or_learning


def test_new_good_starts_first_learning_step():
    card = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.NEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=0)
    grade = Grade.GOOD
    today = date(2026, 1, 1)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3), graduating_interval_days=4)
    expected = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 1, 2), lapses=0, learning_step=0, relearning_interval_days=0, buried_until=None, history=())
    
    result = schedule_new_or_learning(card, grade, today, settings)
    
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)


def test_learning_good_at_last_step_graduates_with_graduating_interval():
    card = Card(id='c2', note_id='n2', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=0, learning_step=1)
    grade = Grade.GOOD
    today = date(2026, 1, 1)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3), graduating_interval_days=4)
    expected = Card(id='c2', note_id='n2', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=4, due_date=date(2026, 1, 5), lapses=0, learning_step=0, relearning_interval_days=0, buried_until=None, history=())
    
    result = schedule_new_or_learning(card, grade, today, settings)
    
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)


def test_learning_again_resets_step_and_preserves_non_schedule_fields():
    event = ReviewEvent(card_id='c3', reviewed_at=dt(2025, 12, 31, 12, 0), grade=Grade.GOOD, seconds=17, state_before=CardState.NEW)
    card = Card(id='c3', note_id='n3', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=1.7, interval_days=9, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=4, learning_step=1, relearning_interval_days=6, buried_until=date(2026, 1, 9), history=(event,))
    grade = Grade.AGAIN
    today = date(2026, 1, 1)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3))
    expected = Card(id='c3', note_id='n3', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=1.7, interval_days=9, due_date=date(2026, 1, 2), lapses=4, learning_step=0, relearning_interval_days=6, buried_until=date(2026, 1, 9), history=(event,))
    
    result = schedule_new_or_learning(card, grade, today, settings)
    
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)


def test_easy_graduates_with_one_day_minimum_and_clears_relearning_interval():
    card = Card(id='c4', note_id='n4', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.8, interval_days=2, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=3, learning_step=1, relearning_interval_days=8, buried_until=date(2026, 1, 4))
    grade = Grade.EASY
    today = date(2026, 1, 1)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(easy_interval_days=0)
    expected = Card(id='c4', note_id='n4', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.8, interval_days=1, due_date=date(2026, 1, 2), lapses=3, learning_step=0, relearning_interval_days=0, buried_until=date(2026, 1, 4), history=())
    
    result = schedule_new_or_learning(card, grade, today, settings)
    
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)


def test_new_hard_behaves_as_again():
    card = Card(id='c5', note_id='n5', state=CardState.NEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=11, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=1, relearning_interval_days=5)
    grade = Grade.HARD
    today = date(2026, 1, 1)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3))
    expected = Card(id='c5', note_id='n5', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.5, interval_days=11, due_date=date(2026, 1, 2), lapses=1, learning_step=0, relearning_interval_days=5, buried_until=None, history=())
    
    result = schedule_new_or_learning(card, grade, today, settings)
    
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)


def test_learning_hard_clamps_oversized_step_before_requesting_hard_delay(monkeypatch):
    def stub_learning_delay_days(settings, step, is_hard):
        return 6

    monkeypatch.setattr('app.logic.learning_delay_days', stub_learning_delay_days)
    
    card = Card(id='c6', note_id='n6', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=0, learning_step=99)
    grade = Grade.HARD
    today = date(2026, 1, 1)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3))

    expected = Card(id='c6', note_id='n6', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 1, 7), lapses=0, learning_step=1, relearning_interval_days=0, buried_until=None, history=())
    
    result = schedule_new_or_learning(card, grade, today, settings)

    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)


def test_learning_good_advances_to_another_step():
    card = Card(id='c7', note_id='n7', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=0, learning_step=0)
    grade = Grade.GOOD
    today = date(2026, 1, 1)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3, 5))
    expected = Card(id='c7', note_id='n7', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 1, 4), lapses=0, learning_step=1, relearning_interval_days=0, buried_until=None, history=())
    
    result = schedule_new_or_learning(card, grade, today, settings)
    
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)


def test_learning_good_graduation_uses_positive_relearning_interval_but_respects_minimum():
    card = Card(id='c8', note_id='n8', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 1, 1), lapses=0, learning_step=1, relearning_interval_days=2)
    grade = Grade.GOOD
    today = date(2026, 1, 1)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(1, 3), graduating_interval_days=9, minimum_interval_days=3)
    expected = Card(id='c8', note_id='n8', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=3, due_date=date(2026, 1, 4), lapses=0, learning_step=0, relearning_interval_days=0, buried_until=None, history=())
    
    result = schedule_new_or_learning(card, grade, today, settings)
    
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)

from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *

def test_learning_sorted_and_ignores_zero_limits():
    cards = (
        Card(id="lb", note_id="n", state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.5, interval_days=1, due_date=date(2026, 1, 8), lapses=0),

import dataclasses
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date, datetime as dt, timedelta
from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import suspend_leech


def test_suspends_review_card_at_threshold_preserving_all_other_fields():
    card = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=21, 
                due_date=date(2026, 10, 20), lapses=8, learning_step=3, 
                relearning_interval_days=5, buried_until=date(2026, 10, 15), 
                history=(ReviewEvent(card_id='c1', reviewed_at=dt(2026, 10, 13, 9, 30), 
                grade=Grade.AGAIN, seconds=42, state_before=CardState.REVIEW),))
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=8)
    expected = Card(id='c1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.SUSPENDED, ease=2.5, 
                    interval_days=21, due_date=date(2026, 10, 20), lapses=8, 
                    learning_step=3, relearning_interval_days=5, 
                    buried_until=date(2026, 10, 15), history=(ReviewEvent(card_id='c1', 
                    reviewed_at=dt(2026, 10, 13, 9, 30), grade=Grade.AGAIN, seconds=42, 
                    state_before=CardState.REVIEW),))
    
    result = suspend_leech(card, settings)
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)


def test_returns_original_card_below_threshold():
    card = Card(id='c2', note_id='n2', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.3, 
                interval_days=10, due_date=date(2026, 10, 14), lapses=7)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=8)

    result = suspend_leech(card, settings)
    assert result is card


def test_suspends_card_above_threshold():
    card = Card(id='c3', note_id='n3', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=1.3, 
                interval_days=1, due_date=date(2026, 10, 13), lapses=12)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=8)
    expected = Card(id='c3', note_id='n3', state=CardState.SUSPENDED, ease=1.3, 
                    interval_days=1, due_date=date(2026, 10, 13), lapses=12)

    result = suspend_leech(card, settings)
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)


def test_suspends_non_review_card_when_lapses_reach_threshold():
    card = Card(id='c4', note_id='n4', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.0, 
                interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 10, 13), lapses=1, learning_step=1)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=1)
    expected = Card(id='c4', note_id='n4', state=CardState.SUSPENDED, ease=2.0, 
                    interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 10, 13), lapses=1, learning_step=1)

def test_does_not_suspend_when_leech_threshold_is_disabled():

    result = suspend_leech(card, settings)

import pytest
import dataclasses
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date, datetime as dt, timedelta
from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import summarise_day

def test_spec_example_good_and_again():
    cards = (
        Card(
            id='c1',
            note_id='n1',
            state=CardState.REVIEW,
            ease=2.5,
            interval_days=10,
            due_date=date(2026, 1, 15),
            lapses=0,
            history=(ReviewEvent(card_id='c1', reviewed_at=dt(2026, 1, 15, 9, 0), grade=Grade.GOOD, seconds=30, state_before=CardState.REVIEW),)
        ),
        Card(
            id='c2',
            note_id='n2',
            state=CardState.REVIEW,
            ease=2.5,
            interval_days=10,
            due_date=date(2026, 1, 15),
            lapses=0,
            history=(ReviewEvent(card_id='c2', reviewed_at=dt(2026, 1, 15, 10, 0), grade=Grade.AGAIN, seconds=10, state_before=CardState.REVIEW),)
        )
    )
    study_date = date(2026, 1, 15)
    expected = DailySummary(study_date=date(2026, 1, 15), grade_counts=((Grade.AGAIN, 1), (Grade.HARD, 0), (Grade.GOOD, 1), (Grade.EASY, 0)), retention_rate=0.5, total_seconds=40, reviewed_cards=2)
    result = summarise_day(cards, study_date)
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)

def test_no_events_empty_input():
    cards = ()
    study_date = date(2026, 2, 1)
    expected = DailySummary(study_date=date(2026, 2, 1), grade_counts=((Grade.AGAIN, 0), (Grade.HARD, 0), (Grade.GOOD, 0), (Grade.EASY, 0)), retention_rate=0.0, total_seconds=0, reviewed_cards=0)
    result = summarise_day(cards, study_date)
    assert dataclasses.asdict(result) == dataclasses.asdict(expected)

def test_events_on_other_dates_are_ignored():
    cards = (
        Card(
            id='c1',
            note_id='n1',

            interval_days=10,

import pytest
import dataclasses
from datetime import date, datetime as dt
from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import grade_card
from unittest.mock import patch

def test_suspended_good_is_identical_and_does_not_call_helpers():
    card = Card(id='s1', note_id='n1', state=CardState.SUSPENDED, ease=2.5, interval_days=12, due_date=date(2026, 5, 1), lapses=3, learning_step=1, relearning_interval_days=2, buried_until=date(2026, 5, 20), history=(ReviewEvent('s1', dt(2026, 5, 2, 8, 0), Grade.AGAIN, 10, CardState.REVIEW),))
    grade = Grade.GOOD
    reviewed_at = dt(2026, 5, 10, 9, 30)
    seconds = -4
    settings = SchedulerSettings()
    
    result = grade_card(card, grade, reviewed_at, seconds, settings)
    
    assert result == card

def test_new_easy_schedules_then_appends_clamped_event_and_preserves_history():
    old_event = ReviewEvent('other', dt(2026, 5, 1, 7, 0), Grade.GOOD, 9, CardState.NEW)
    card = Card(id='new1', note_id='n2', state=CardState.NEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 5, 10), lapses=0, history=(old_event,))
    grade = Grade.EASY
    reviewed_at = dt(2026, 5, 10, 23, 59, 58)
    seconds = -9
    settings = SchedulerSettings()
    scheduled = Card(id='new1', note_id='n2', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=7, due_date=date(2026, 5, 17), lapses=0, history=(old_event,))

    with patch('app.logic.schedule_new_or_learning', return_value=scheduled) as mock_schedule_new_or_learning, \
         patch('app.logic.suspend_leech', return_value=scheduled) as mock_suspend_leech, \
         patch('app.logic.schedule_review') as mock_schedule_review:

        result = grade_card(card, grade, reviewed_at, seconds, settings)

    assert result == Card(id='new1', note_id='n2', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=7, due_date=date(2026, 5, 17), lapses=0, history=(old_event, ReviewEvent('new1', reviewed_at, grade, 0, CardState.NEW)))
    mock_schedule_new_or_learning.assert_called_once_with(card, Grade.EASY, date(2026, 5, 10), settings)
    mock_suspend_leech.assert_called_once_with(scheduled, settings)

def test_learning_hard_uses_learning_scheduler_and_appends_event():
    card = Card(id='l1', note_id='n3', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.2, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 5, 10), lapses=1, learning_step=1, relearning_interval_days=2)
    grade = Grade.HARD
    reviewed_at = dt(2026, 5, 10, 0, 0, 1)
    seconds = 4
    settings = SchedulerSettings()
    scheduled = Card(id='l1', note_id='n3', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.2, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 5, 13), lapses=1, learning_step=1, relearning_interval_days=2)

    with patch('app.logic.schedule_new_or_learning', return_value=scheduled) as mock_schedule_new_or_learning, \
         patch('app.logic.suspend_leech', return_value=scheduled) as mock_suspend_leech, \
         patch('app.logic.schedule_review') as mock_schedule_review:

        result = grade_card(card, grade, reviewed_at, seconds, settings)

    assert result == Card(id='l1', note_id='n3', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.2, interval_days=0, due_date=date(2026, 5, 13), lapses=1, learning_step=1, relearning_interval_days=2, history=(ReviewEvent('l1', reviewed_at, grade, seconds, CardState.LEARNING),))
    mock_schedule_new_or_learning.assert_called_once_with(card, Grade.HARD, date(2026, 5, 10), settings)
    mock_suspend_leech.assert_called_once_with(scheduled, settings)

def test_review_again_at_leech_threshold_is_suspended_then_gets_event():
    card = Card(id='r1', note_id='n4', state=CardState.REVIEW, ease=2.5, interval_days=10, due_date=date(2026, 5, 1), lapses=7)
    grade = Grade.AGAIN
    reviewed_at = dt(2026, 5, 10, 12, 0)
    seconds = 31
    settings = SchedulerSettings(leech_threshold=8)
    scheduled = Card(id='r1', note_id='n4', state=CardState.LEARNING, ease=2.3, interval_days=10, due_date=date(2026, 5, 11), lapses=8, relearning_interval_days=5)
    suspended = Card(id='r1', note_id='n4', state=CardState.SUSPENDED, ease=2.3, interval_days=10, due_date=date(2026, 5, 11), lapses=8, relearning_interval_days=5)

    with patch('app.logic.schedule_review', return_value=scheduled) as mock_schedule_review, \
         patch('app.logic.suspend_leech', return_value=suspended) as mock_suspend_leech, \
         patch('app.logic.schedule_new_or_learning') as mock_schedule_new_or_learning:

        result = grade_card(card, grade, reviewed_at, seconds, settings)

    assert result == Card(id='r1', note_id='n4', state=CardState.SUSPENDED, ease=2.3, interval_days=10, due_date=date(2026, 5, 11), lapses=8, relearning_interval_days=5, history=(ReviewEvent('r1', reviewed_at, grade, seconds, CardState.REVIEW),))
    mock_schedule_review.assert_called_once_with(card, Grade.AGAIN, date(2026, 5, 10), settings)
    mock_suspend_leech.assert_called_once_with(scheduled, settings)
